_notes: ReefTank layout (P1.1). Coordinates are design pixels at 1920x1080 inside the camera Group; ReefTank scales the camera by screen width / design.width. layers run back to front, each built as a Group whose id is the layer id; name is the PRD scene-stack label. parallax is the per-layer drift factor P1.2 applies to the camera offset (0 = fixed, 1 = moves with the camera); the values here are placeholders. drift (P1.2) is the camera loop: amplitude is in design px and the validator rejects an amplitude where parallax * amplitude exceeds the art margin of a decor that spans the view (the reef backdrop has 313 px of margin left and right and none above or below, so y stays 0). A layer with a lane block is a fish lane: rect bounds the fish anchor, scale and tint (0xRRGGBBAA multiply) set the lane's depth. Until P1.7 splits the art, the single painted backdrop (water, back rock and coral in one image) sits in waterGradient, centered with 313 px of drift margin on each side; coral_acropora stands in midCoral so back-lane fish pass behind it. Colors are hex strings because JSON integers cannot hold the 32-bit RGBA values.

bubbles._notes: P1.3 pooled bubble column (components/Bubbles, logic in components/lib/bubbles.brs), built in the bubbles layer. pool Posters share uri and are created once; slot i rises from sources[i mod n] (x, y = start, top = end, spread = +- x jitter in px) and recycles in place. Sizes are px, rise is seconds for the full climb, wobble is the horizontal sine amplitude in px over wobbleCycles periods per climb, gapMax the longest pause before a recycled bubble starts. Optional keys fall back to defaults in bubblesDefaults().

seaweed._notes: P1.4 segmented seaweed (components/Seaweed): one Seaweed component per stalk, placed in its layer with its base at (x, y). segmentUris run base to tip (tools/art/seaweed.py); each Poster is segmentSize and the next segment starts segmentStep px higher, so joints overlap by segmentSize[1] - segmentStep px. Segment k swings amplitudeDeg * (0.5 + 0.5 * k / (n - 1)) degrees with a lag of k * phaseStepDeg, so the bend travels up the stalk over period seconds. scale must stay positive (fidelity F4). tint is a 0xRRGGBBAA multiply.

population._notes: Tank fish (P2.7). ReefTank builds one FishBrain per lane that has fish, inside that lane's Group, and one School in school.lane. Each gets the lane rect from layers[].lane.rect and the world below as overrides on brainUri/behaviorUri/schoolUri, which keep the motion parameters and the species-to-kind map. Lane scale and tint are applied per fish (scale about the rig mirror_center, tint as Poster blendColor). Positions are design pixels of the fish anchor, measured on the painted backdrop (docs/preview/reef-tank-empty.png is 1:1 with design pixels). ellipses keep fish anchors out of the rock masses: e0 arch top, e1 arch left pillar, e2 arch right pillar, e3 centre reef under the red plate coral, e4 right reef, e5 far-right rock, e6 brain coral and staghorn; the arch opening (x 300-610, y 510-760) is left free so back-lane fish pass behind the acropora. caves: the round hole in the arch's left pillar, the through-hole between the centre and right reef, and the dark recess under the far-right rocks; mouth and den sit outside every ellipse. rocks are graze points on real rock or coral tops. band is the sand line in front of the reef for the mandarin. densities: per lane [{species, count}] plus the chromis school {lane, count}; ReefTank.density picks one (default normal, unknown names fall back to normal).
